# GPT Image 2 Hub · AI Image Inspiration Atlas

![GPT Image 2](https://img.shields.io/badge/model-GPT--Image--2-10a37f?logo=openai&logoColor=white) ![Works](https://img.shields.io/badge/dynamic/json?url=https%3A%2F%2Fraw.githubusercontent.com%2FChaosRealmsAI%2Fgpt-image-2-gallery%2Fmain%2Fworks%2Findex.json&query=%24.stats.image_count&label=works&color=blue) ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green) ![Live Site](https://img.shields.io/badge/live-vercel-black?logo=vercel)

A curated atlas of **GPT-Image-2** (ChatGPT Images 2.0 · OpenAI · released 2026-04-21) generations. Every work ships with its full prompt — copy and remix.

**443 topics · 692 packages · 3798 works** · [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

## What is GPT Image 2 Hub?

**GPT Image 2 Hub** is a public atlas of prompts for **GPT-Image-2** — OpenAI's next-generation image model released on **April 21, 2026** (also called **ChatGPT Images 2.0**, powered by the GPT-5.4 backbone). This repository catalogs **3798 curated works** across **443 themes** and **692 packages**, every generation paired with its full copy-paste prompt so the output can be reproduced or remixed directly.

## Who it's for

- **Designers & illustrators** — reproducible style references across 10 visual categories
- **Prompt engineers** — multilingual text rendering, layout control, style anchoring
- **Content creators** — posters, covers, infographics, editorial imagery at scale
- **Researchers** — benchmarking GPT-Image-2 against specific creative constraints

## How to use

1. Browse by **category** (typography, illustration, photography…) or by **theme** (fictional symbol systems, multi-script posters…).
2. Click any work to open the live page — it includes the **full prompt in English and Chinese**.
3. Copy the prompt into ChatGPT Images 2.0 · reproduce, tweak, remix.
4. Licensed MIT — prompts are free to ship commercially.

## FAQ

**What is GPT Image 2 / gpt-image-2 / ChatGPT Images 2.0?**
Three names for the same model: OpenAI's next-generation image generation model released on **April 21, 2026**. It renders text with ~99% accuracy across Latin, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Hindi, and Bengali scripts; outputs up to **4096×4096**; and runs roughly 2× faster than its predecessor. Natively integrated into ChatGPT on the GPT-5.4 backbone.

**What makes this atlas different from a random prompt dump?**
Every entry is curated, reproducible, and localized (EN + 简体中文). Themes are versioned by stable slug; works inside a theme share a controlled design language so style transfer is explicit rather than accidental.

**Can I reuse the prompts commercially?**
Yes — repository code and prompt text are MIT licensed.

**How is the content organized?**
Themes → packages → works. A **theme** (e.g. `fictional-symbol-system`) groups **packages** (series studies or single explorations), and each package lists individual **works** with full metadata (title, description, alt text, prompt, bilingual labels).

**How do I reproduce a specific work?**
Open its live page, copy either the English or Chinese prompt verbatim into ChatGPT Images 2.0, and run. Outputs vary slightly between runs — that is expected.

**How often is the atlas updated?**
Continuously. New themes are added weekly; existing themes are expanded as new visual patterns emerge in GPT-Image-2.
